capacity:uploads.title: Render requests can't keep up
capacity:uploads.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 2/s and can't handle any: its backlog only grows.
capacity:uploads.rationale: Demand above what a service can handle never drains: latency and backlog grow until something times out. Live view's Show capacity has the same numbers.

capacity:worker.title: Poster workers: resource planning
capacity:worker.message: At 2/s, up to 60 messages arrive before the 30 s poll, plus 1 s startup. Lower polling interval or raise minimum replicas. This is a configured estimate.
capacity:worker.rationale: Configured resource assumptions; steady state is not a burst guarantee.
capacity:worker.shownRationale: Configured resource assumptions; this is a steady-state estimate, not a burst guarantee.
